chunks: Who do not associate any one with their Lord,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to not associate partners with God in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this attribute is often linked to the concept of *Tawhid al-Af'ali* (Unity of Actions), where believers recognize God as the sole effective agent in the universe, extending beyond mere verbal declaration to internal conviction. This purity of monotheism serves as a foundational criterion for the true *Mu'minun*, distinguishing them from those who associate partners with God through idolatry or attributing divine qualities to created beings. The verse thus encapsulates the essence of exclusive devotion that characterizes the ideal believer in Islamic theology.
